title: Shark Attacks 2025: 65 Confirmed Unprovoked Bites Worldwide 🦈 (Would Meatball Survive? #4)
description:
How many shark attacks were there in 2025? The International Shark Attack File confirmed 65 unprovoked shark bites on people worldwide in 2025, nine of them fatal, counted 29 provoked bites separately, and says the chances of being bitten remain extremely low. Its tips: swim with a buddy and not at dawn or dusk. If a shark comes close, keep eye contact, move away slowly and leave the water if you can. If it bites, hit the eyes and gills, and do not act passively.
